title: How to Buy Land | for Beginners
description:
Get our How to Buy Land Workbook that includes worksheets, due diligence checklists, financing breakdowns, land comparison sheets, and more.
➡️ Click here to download the workbook: https://generalfamilyhome.myshopify.com/products/how-to-buy-land-workbook

Thinking about buying land but not sure where to start? In this video, we break down everything you need to know about how to buy land—from finding the right property to understanding how big 1 acre really is.
What you’ll learn in this video:
• How to find land for sale (including the best websites to search)
• What to look for before purchasing land (utilities, zoning, access, and more)
• Is 1 acre enough?
Whether you’re looking to build your dream home, start a homestead, or invest in property, this beginner’s guide to buying land will help you make smart decisions and avoid costly mistakes.

If you’re interested in buying land, building a home, or starting from scratch with your family, subscribe and follow along. We’re documenting the entire process from land clearing, designing, moving in and everything in between. We want you to go on this journey with us.

👉 Don’t forget to like, subscribe, and turn on the notification bell to follow us along our journey to build our dream home on 5 acres!
